directoryStems.mcq-5532092db0b792ed3225a956: A physician assesses a 78-year-old man with mild dementia for capacity to decide about surgery. Which is not one of the patient's abilities required for a capable decision?
directoryStems.mcq-df7971704247f167ddb8fe7d: Who is responsible for the clinical assessment of capacity to make a medical decision?
directoryStems.mcq-80336caa7072f6b06f3f05d4: An 82-year-old woman is considering consent for joint replacement. Which is not one of the four elements of clinical decision-making capacity described in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-ceb8b3e359edc561601ffe05: An 84-year-old man with mild cognitive impairment, MMSE 23, and heart failure attends after his wife’s sudden death from stroke. He says he does not want to end up connected to machines. His daughter interrupts and says he does not know what he is saying and should receive every treatment. He has no written advance directive and his creatinine clearance is 42 mL/min. Which step is appropriate before transferring decisions to his daughter or writing a treatment-limitation order?
directoryStems.mcq-b405bff777bf6fa7c48f0506: An 82-year-old African American woman with ESRD on hemodialysis, severe peripheral arterial disease, and diabetes has right-foot gangrene. Vascular surgery recommends below-knee amputation. She refuses, saying she would rather die whole than live in pieces. Her son demands surgery, but psychiatric assessment confirms capacity for this decision. Which response respects her established decisional capacity?
directoryStems.mcq-d8e73631331c186fe16dd925: A 79-year-old woman with mild cognitive impairment, legal blindness from macular degeneration, and a recent hip fracture is preparing for discharge from rehabilitation. She lives alone and wants to return home, despite two falls during rehabilitation and a physical therapist's finding that she needs supervision for safe walking. Her daughter requests nursing-home placement. MMSE is 27/30, with orientation and memory errors. What should guide assessment of her ability to decide about returning home?
